articles.title: ‘Interview With The Vampire’ Season 3: ‘The Vampire Lestat’ Episode 1 Ending Explained: Who is “Toi”? Meet Lestat’s Mother (and Lover) Gabriella
articles.summary: AMC has rebranded "Interview With the Vampire" Season 3 as "The Vampire Lestat," honoring the show's new narrator. Following two seasons tracing Louis de Pointe due Lac's saga, the upcoming season will shift its narrative focus. This change signifies an evolving storytelling approach within the popular series, potentially offering a fresh perspective on Anne Rice's iconic characters.

articles.title: Revealed: Just how defenceless we would be if Putin DID attack Britain
articles.summary: Britain faces an unprecedented threat, primarily from Iran, which has already targeted its overseas bases. There are growing concerns that Iran may possess hypersonic missiles capable of striking London. This highlights the evolving global security landscape and the critical importance of robust defence strategies to counter advanced conventional and unconventional threats from state actors.

articles.title: European allies and Zelenskiy urge ‘immediate’ ceasefire with Ukraine after meeting
articles.summary: Leaders from the UK, Ukraine, France, and Germany recently discussed the urgent need to significantly increase the production of defensive weapons and deep-strike capabilities. This imperative follows Russia's use of Oreshnik missiles against Ukraine, emphasizing the conflict's evolving nature. The discussion highlights the critical importance of strengthening Ukraine's long-term defence posture and ensuring sustained military support and strategic deterrence.

articles.title: Stream It Or Skip It: ‘The Vampire Lestat’ On AMC, Where Lestat Goes On Tour With A Garage Band And Deals With Vampires From His Past
articles.summary: The third season of AMC's "Interview With The Vampire" adaptation is undergoing a major transformation, being renamed "The Vampire Lestat." This signifies a narrative pivot, moving beyond just exploring past events. The upcoming season promises a fresh, perhaps more present-focused, direction for the character Lestat, marking a substantial new chapter for the Anne Rice series.

articles.title: RITES of passage to hyper-competition
articles.summary: RITES CMD Rahul Mithal confidently projects 2026-27 as a year of disruptive growth for the Indian PSU. This optimism is underpinned by RITES achieving an all-time high order book of ₹9,416 crore as of March 31. Such strong financial performance reflects the company's robust position in national infrastructure, particularly railways, indicating significant contributions to India's economic development and future project pipeline.
